parameters.excerpt: For each bit in 61:58, if the associated privilege mode is not implemented, the bit is read-only zero.
parameters.reasoning: Whether each of the xINH bits (SINH, UINH, VSINH, VUINH) in mcyclecfg/minstretcfg is read-only zero depends on whether the associated privilege mode is implemented. This is an implementation choice about which bits are writable vs. read-only-zero, making it a NORM_CSR_RW parameter. The same applies to minstretcfg by symmetry.

parameters.excerpt: Mode transition operations (traps and trap returns) may take multiple clock cycles, and the change of privilege mode may be reported as occurring in any one of those cycles (possibly different for each occurrence of a trap or trap return).
parameters.modal_signal: may be reported as occurring in any one of those cycles
parameters.reasoning: The spec explicitly states that the cycle in which a privilege mode change is reported during a trap/trap-return is an implementation choice ('may be reported as occurring in any one of those cycles'). This is a design-time decision about cycle counting behavior during mode transitions, not controlled by any CSR field.
